about_the_game:
The end of the world presents new opportunities in the Scandinavian Arctic. Equip yourself with the necessary equipment to unleash a fiery Armageddon in the freezing wastelands.

This pack includes:


  • Field Researcher (Absolution) Uniform set
  • Expedition Guard (Absolution) Headgear set
  • 5x M4A1 + 300 x Ammo: 5.56x45 NATO
  • Snow White Skin for M4A1
  • Nebula Skin for M4A1
  • 5x L86A1 LSW + 300 x Ammo: 5.56x45 NATO
  • Snow Black Skin for L86A1 LSW
  • Mamba Skin for L86A1 LSW
  • 5x ADR-97 + 500 x Ammo 5.7x28
  • Snow Blue Skin for ADR-97
  • Leopard Skin for ADR-97
  • 10x Radiation Grenade
  • 10x Iodine
  • 10x Armor Plate
  • 200x Crowns

This pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
